changes.title: Menu shows one section at a time, each row with an Add button
changes.why: The menu is a very long list where nothing says it can be added; sections plus a clear Add button make it fit one screen and look pressable (rules 3c, 3s).

changes.title: Pick your bowl fits one screen, photo beside the choices
changes.why: The heading, five bowls and the photo ran well past one screen, so the photo and button were out of sight; they now sit together (rule 3c).

changes.title: Order page: three-step bar, section tabs, and a bin on every basket line
changes.why: Orders run in steps with a visible progress bar and a remove button on each line, instead of one long form with a hidden basket (rules 3k, videos on booking steps).

changes.title: Order steps: Back button, and the last button names the total
changes.why: The button should say what happens next and its price ("Send order on WhatsApp, ₪50"), and every step needs a way back (rules 3k, 3s.17).

changes.title: Gift boxes get a real button that names the price
changes.why: A small underlined link with an arrow was the only way to order a gift box; a button saying "Order the small box, ₪135" shows the consequence at the moment of choice, and the box names are now larger than their prices (rule 3s.5 and 3s.17).

changes.title: Phone: menu sections as tabs, Add button on each row
changes.why: On a phone the menu was a very long scroll with no sign you can tap to add; sections and an Add button make it quick (rules 3c, 3s).

changes.title: Phone order: bottom bar names the next step, menu in tabs
changes.why: The phone order page was one very long list with a bar saying only "Send on WhatsApp"; section tabs and a bar that says "To delivery" show what happens next (rules 3k, 3s.17).

changes.title: Phone order: each step has its own screen and a Back button
changes.why: One question per screen keeps each step short and thumb-friendly (rules 3k, qualities from the booking-step videos).

questions: Do the gift boxes cost more than the items inside because of the kraft box and packaging? If you offer any real saving on a box, tell us the amount and we will show it as money saved.
Can customers cancel or change an order, and until when? A true line on this under the order button would reassure people.
Which item sells most, and do you want it marked? We will only add a label if you say so.
Do you have a photo of yourself or the kitchen where the bowls are made? A short "made at home in Jerusalem" photo would add a personal touch beside the menu.
What delivery fee range and delivery days can we state on the page, instead of "depends on your location"?
checks_now: Home page: arrow glyph missing in the font, gift box names barely bigger than their lines, a 24 px jump when Build your own is chosen, hero words hidden with motion off, bowls and menu sections taller than one screen. Order page: no hover on the send button, the form section taller than one screen. After the changes all checks pass.
